summary: YPF S.A., an Argentine energy company, filed a 6-K reporting the launch of two cash tender offers for its own outstanding notes: the 6.950% Senior Notes due 2027 and the 2.500%/9.000% Step-Up Amortizing Notes due 2029, with a maximum aggregate purchase price of US$500 million excluding accrued interest. The offers are concurrent with a new notes offering (Class XLIV Negotiable Obligations) to fund the purchases. Acceptance is subject to priority levels: 2027 Notes at US$1,017.50 per US$1,000 principal and 2029 Notes at US$1,042.00. Conditions include consummation of the new offering and proration procedures. What to watch: the success of the new notes issuance and tender participation rates, which will affect debt reduction and refinancing outcomes.
